svg.title: The two credential guards
svg.desc: Files, on by default: before the model reads a file, ZeroTurn scans that file and the harness asks you, or denies with mode deny, or stays silent with mode off. Messages you send, off by default: when switched on, each message is scanned before it is sent and one carrying a credential is stopped, which means ZeroTurn reads your messages in that repository and the harness erases a stopped message. In both cases the check runs on your machine, nothing is stored, and the explanation names the file, the line, and the kind, never the value.
svg.text: Before a file is opened, ZeroTurn
scans it and the harness asks you.
Switch it on and a message holding
a key is stopped before it is sent.
Both checks run on your machine. Nothing from a file or a message is stored, logged, or sent anywhere.
The explanation names the file, the line, and the kind of credential. Never the value.
